selected.rationale: Loss on WebApp->Ordering.API hits the statically confirmed no-timeout synchronous checkout path; the request hangs until the client deadline, exposing missing timeout/retry defenses in order placement.
WebApp->Catalog.API is also statically confirmed with no timeout; full packet loss makes catalog browsing hang and breaks storefront availability.
Delay on the same verified no-timeout ordering edge propagates unboundedly into checkout, so the order flow stalls up to the client deadline and reveals unbounded latency propagation.
With no per-request timeout on WebApp->Catalog.API, injected delay is unbounded and slows or hangs catalog rendering for storefront users.
Basket.API uses the same unguarded typed-HttpClient wiring as the confirmed no-timeout services; loss on this cart/checkout dependency hangs basket operations and blocks checkout.
Mobile BFF ordering is a core synchronous order-placement path; loss likely hits the same no-timeout HTTP pattern and stalls mobile orders until the client deadline.
Delay on the Mobile BFF->Ordering.API edge propagates 1:1 with no bound, causing mobile checkout latency to grow and hang, indicating missing timeout/recovery behavior.
The WebApp->Basket.API HttpClient is not timeout-bounded; delay on this cart edge produces unbounded latency in cart interactions and checkout progress.
